title: Driftport (Sandbox Example)
description: An original example of the sandbox pattern: a one-line hook, a short Author's Note, and empty AI Instructions. Steering is minimal; the world knowledge lives in a small set of story cards (cards.json).
prompt: The freighter drops you at Driftport with a duffel, a week of credits, and no plan. The station never sleeps. What do you do?
authorsNote:
Perspective: second person, present tense.
Detailed and grounded; player-led, open-ended.
